Расплавленное золото, расплескавшись, подожгло сухой мусор на земле, а один из копейщиков, которому брызги попали на ногу, с диким воплем боли отскочил в сторону. Но Жрец Солнца быстро овладел собой. Схватив горшок с огнём, он уже собирался поджечь хворост, наваленный вокруг трёх его жертв, когда вмешалась девочка.", "source_sha256": "cff16543d569efc6c2a172f3ced8e2921b4bcd5d3b5b5b68817869fccbfe10ad", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u019-r0079", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7f47fa4ac72c3dd9b461dd3c011ef4c11fdb939c8085ff9eb67645f091bc02bb"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u019-r0080", "tag": "p", "text": "“The Sun God would not let the great captain drink the drink,” she said. “The Sun God spilled it from your hand.”", "sha256": "b08aecca1eceec5f41bf737ff8afedd8c5e2a42938116f5b1fcdd5fd4e60d730", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1616]", "source_html": "

“The Sun God would not let the great captain drink the drink,” she said. “The Sun God spilled it from your hand.”

Nevertheless was he resolved on the destruction of the three intruders. So, craftily, he addressed his people.", "sha256": "990a5b71c96473e722786b9f4e1eed1a1d70d01662755f39bf09b673f2c4f274", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1617]", "source_html": "

And when all the Lost Souls began to murmur that there was more in the matter than appeared to their priest, the latter was compelled to hold his hand. Nevertheless was he resolved on the destruction of the three intruders. So, craftily, he addressed his people.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0082", "tag": "p", "text": "“We shall wait for a sign.—Bring oil. We will give the Sun God time for a sign.——Bring a candle.”", "sha256": "c2900b8b041d8dc8a371cc5b4cd7f76931ba7467a7bc7e1cf75eb460ac9fdc12", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1618]", "source_html": "

“We shall wait for a sign.—Bring oil. We will give the Sun God time for a sign.——Bring a candle.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0083", "tag": "p", "text": "Pouring the jar of oil over the faggots to make them more inflammable, he set the lighted stub of a candle in the midst of the saturated fuel, and said:", "sha256": "070b44567ce724bada87996d67604fc37e231c56d2107ff22ee5b317f81c27ef", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1619]", "source_html": "

Pouring the jar of oil over the faggots to make them more inflammable, he set the lighted stub of a candle in the midst of the saturated fuel, and said:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0084", "tag": "p", "text": "“The life of the candle will be the duration of the time for the sign. Is it well, O People?”", "sha256": "c1206c167ef599b27494a6c5887c0b101cab164cbadc517e967c84d80c852979", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1620]", "source_html": "

175“The life of the candle will be the duration of the time for the sign. Is it well, O People?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0085", "tag": "p", "text": "And all the Lost Souls murmured, “It is well.”", "sha256": "ae793d0fdeaa4e6c3ced822d53d3d1c18bba9a7d377e8cf46d8d26209e977394", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1621]", "source_html": "

And all the Lost Souls murmured, “It is well.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0086", "tag": "p", "text": "Torres looked appeal to Francis, who replied:", "sha256": "d92f07e4625e3259084918cbb356a43915b21f014f5d0a2710680f66d226cd13", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1622]", "source_html": "

Torres looked appeal to Francis, who replied:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0087", "tag": "p", "text": "“The old brute certainly pinched on the length of the candle. It won’t last five minutes at best, and, maybe, inside three minutes we’ll be going up in smoke.”", "sha256": "daf175fea95bd5fafe7050b5aae43a436e0730a6784802f726f346b5b8bb5601", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1623]", "source_html": "

“The old brute certainly pinched on the length of the candle. It won’t last five minutes at best, and, maybe, inside three minutes we’ll be going up in smoke.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0088", "tag": "p", "text": "“What can we do?” Torres demanded frantically, while Leoncia looked bravely, with a sad brave smile of love, into Francis’ eyes.", "sha256": "75c71f0e5d8f59384e9ef5e7e31281d4d23080b8cbe0e21843d004cdcbffd0aa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1624]", "source_html": "

“What can we do?” Torres demanded frantically, while Leoncia looked bravely, with a sad brave smile of love, into Francis’ eyes.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0089", "tag": "p", "text": "“Pray for rain,” Francis answered. “And the sky is as clear as a bell. After that, die game. Don’t squeal too loud.”", "sha256": "320d669bbbded3281257497105bd0e1cdf9f0b05beb96c30d8d526f99fa944b5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1625]", "source_html": "

“Pray for rain,” Francis answered. “And the sky is as clear as a bell. After that, die game. Don’t squeal too loud.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0090", "tag": "p", "text": "And his eyes returned to Leoncia’s and expressed what he had never dared express to her before——his full heart of love. Apart, by virtue of the posts to which they were tied and which separated them, they had never been so close together, and the bond that drew them and united them was their eyes.", "sha256": "9c4b5a10ab14bf60dd9cfd8cde5a3233750f3ebe863d19a39b5bdb53aa0b78f6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1626]", "source_html": "

And his eyes returned to Leoncia’s and expressed what he had never dared express to her before——his full heart of love. Apart, by virtue of the posts to which they were tied and which separated them, they had never been so close together, and the bond that drew them and united them was their eyes.

Torres, who had eyes only for the candle stub, nearly burned to its base, heard the maid’s cry and looked up. And at the same time he heard, as all of them heard, the droning flight as of some monstrous insect in the sky.", "sha256": "411aa6f25aed897523407879b1b922150d8639a81ef6c4bb6dc31278223d192f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1627]", "source_html": "

First of all, the little maid, gazing into the sky for the sign, saw it. Torres, who had eyes only for the candle stub, nearly burned to its base, heard the maid’s cry and looked up. And at the same time he heard, as all of them heard, the droning flight as of some monstrous insect in the sky.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0092", "tag": "p", "text": "“An aeroplane,” Francis muttered. “Torres, claim it for the sign.”", "sha256": "36c3ea304df460687f3572eec58a8dc9eb10e78e75fca32bf7df3ec0100a8018", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1628]", "source_html": "

“An aeroplane,” Francis muttered. “Torres, claim it for the sign.”
